svg.aria-label: Glyph: a course-provided C++ MNIST network, hand-optimised — AVX-512, AVX2 and NEON kernels over a scalar fallback, written with Shree Chaturvedi; the React and TypeScript browser app is the author's own. The committed benchmarks answer both ways: 3.5 times faster on the 256 dot kernel under OpenMP and native codegen, and 10.7 times slower on the 128 axpy, because parallelism has a floor. Accuracy is unchanged at 97.01 percent on the 10,000-image MNIST test set, which means 299 wrong — every one of them drawn as a grid of the labels it missed, and the 79 it was most confident about drawn heavier and in the accent.
svg.title: Glyph — borrowed code made 3.5x faster, same 97.01%
